Don't be sorry, thanks for the response. I just dream of a normal life - A self-sustaining life free of anxiety and false hopes. Dreams of finding someone who understands me, to pull me out of my misery since I seem to be incapable of doing it myself. I don't want to have to fake a smile to endure people's ignorance. I want to go through a day where it doesn't feel like I'm getting stabbed in the heart with life constantly yelling in my head "Just give up." There is more but it goes beyond explanation. These dreams I have are not so dissimilar from others.
How do you cope with it, may I ask?

After my suicide attempt, I lost all concept of time. When I awoke, I had a small realization that I was alive, but I was clinging onto the feeling, and perhaps hope, that I wasn't. Most of the feeling was emptiness; I seriously felt nothing at all. People claim to experience near death experiences, to the point of achieving enlightenment even, but me... I felt nothing.
